highlights.title: A redesigned desktop app
highlights.text: A status panel on the left shows your build and whether ExileLens is ready, with Overview, Settings and Diagnostics beside it.

highlights.title: Analyze Build is part of the main app
highlights.text: Your strongest measured improvements and next actions now sit beside Overview, Settings and Diagnostics.

highlights.title: Seamless automatic updates
highlights.text: Patreon supporters can have verified updates downloaded automatically and installed when ExileLens closes. Manual updates stay free.

minor.text: Usage stats and crash reports are optional and off until you turn them on; Settings shows exactly what would be sent.
Pre-release versions now show their update status correctly.
After an update, ExileLens tells you whether it installed or the previous version was restored.
The Diagnostics entry shows how many things need your attention.
